entities.name: UAC-0050
entities.gloss: A financially motivated and espionage-focused threat actor known for targeting Ukrainian organizations and individuals.

entities.name: Fire Cells Group
entities.gloss: A persona or brand used by threat actor UAC-0050 to conduct information and psychological operations.

entities.name: UAC-0006
entities.gloss: A financially motivated threat actor active since 2013 targeting financial accounts of organizations and individuals.

entities.name: REMCOS
entities.gloss: A commercial remote access trojan frequently abused by cybercriminals for remote management and data theft.

entities.name: TEKTONITRMS
entities.gloss: A legitimate remote administration software product abused by attackers for unauthorized remote computer access.

entities.name: MEDUZASTEALER
entities.gloss: An information-stealing malware family designed to harvest credentials, browser data, and cryptocurrency information.

entities.name: LUMMASTEALER
entities.gloss: An information stealer malware sold on dark web forums that targets browser credentials, cookies, and crypto wallets.

entities.name: XENORAT
entities.gloss: An open-source remote access trojan written in C# providing full control over compromised systems.

entities.name: SECTOPRAT
entities.gloss: A remote access trojan capable of creating hidden desktop sessions and executing unauthorized commands.

entities.name: MARSSTEALER
entities.gloss: An information-stealing malware designed to extract sensitive data from web browsers, extensions, and system applications.

entities.name: DARKTRACKRAT
entities.gloss: A remote access trojan tool facilitating remote control and keylogging on infected Windows systems.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A sovereign state in Eastern Europe whose organizations and enterprises are targeted in cyberattacks.
